intent.outcome: mp builds in <60s with <=100 transitive crates (down from 264) and no behavior change, by first pinning jsonschema features (Phase 1, zero risk) then replacing jsonschema with a ~250-line mini_schema validator (Phase 2, oracle-backed) that uses only serde_json + regex (both already deps). Comprehensive unit + oracle-parity + integration + e2e tests guarantee no behavior drift.

problem.description: Cargo.toml declares 11 runtime deps but pulls in 264 unique transitive crates. The bulk comes from jsonschema's default features (reqwest, rustls, aws-lc-rs, tokio, tower, icu_*, idna, regex-automata full DFA, hyper, h2) which enable HTTP+TLS+async+crypto schema resolution that the code never uses — mp validates only local JSON parsed from TOML. aws-lc-sys alone (cmake-built crypto) accounts for ~60s of the 1m40s release build. Audit of all 7 schema files (milestone, brief, track, idea, challenge, plan, spec-domain) shows mp uses a tiny subset of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12: type, required, properties, pattern (regex), enum, minLength, minItems, minimum, items, internal $ref (#/$defs/), anyOf. Never used: external $ref, oneOf/allOf/not, if/then/else, format, patternProperties, additionalProperties, $id resolution, HTTP fetch. This subset is implementable in ~250 lines using serde_json + regex (both already deps), eliminating jsonschema entirely.

in_scope: Phase 1 (zero risk): pin jsonschema to default-features=false, features=['resolve-file']; pin tera, chrono, serde_json, serde, toml, clap, regex features to minimal sets; verify schema enforcement + render unchanged; add make dep-audit target with transitive-count gate <=150

Phase 2 (medium risk, oracle-backed): implement crates/mp/src/mini_schema.rs (~250 lines) supporting type/required/properties/pattern/enum/minLength/minItems/minimum/items/$ref(internal)/anyOf; replace jsonschema::Validator with mini_schema::Validator in schema.rs; remove jsonschema from Cargo.toml

Test strategy (comprehensive, lands before Phase 2 code): unit tests per keyword (type, required, properties, pattern, enum, minLength, minItems, minimum, items, $ref, anyOf) in tests/mini_schema_unit.rs; oracle parity tests that run both jsonschema and mini_schema on a corpus of valid+invalid fixtures per schema and assert identical pass/fail + error count in tests/mini_schema_parity.rs; schema-specific fixture tests for all 7 schemas (1+ valid, 5+ invalid per schema) in tests/mini_schema_fixtures.rs; e2e tests that mp milestone create / brief done / track add / idea create / challenge still reject invalid input via mini_schema in tests/mini_schema_e2e.rs; keep jsonschema as a dev-dependency during Phase 2 for the parity oracle, remove it only after parity tests pass 100%

Fixture corpus: tests/fixtures/schema-corpus/ with subdirs per schema (milestone/, brief/, track/, idea/, challenge/, plan/, spec-domain/) each containing valid.json + invalid-*.json files covering each rejection reason
Record before/after crate count and build time in M21 evidence
Document dep policy + mini_schema design in ARCHITECTURE.md conventions section (M20 will land it)
out_of_scope: Replacing tera with hand-rolled renderers (M17 R8 may consolidate render anyway)
Removing direct deps other than jsonschema (only feature pinning for the rest)
Changing the schema files themselves (the 7 .schema.json files stay as-is)

Supporting JSON Schema keywords we don't use (oneOf, allOf, not, if/then/else, format, patternProperties, additionalProperties, external $ref) — explicitly reject them with a clear error if encountered
Writing ARCHITECTURE.md (M20's job — M21 feeds it the dep policy + mini_schema design)

steps.action: Create crates/mp/src/mini_schema.rs core: pub struct Validator { schema: Value, defs: HashMap<String, Value> } with pub fn new(schema: &Value) -> Result<Validator> (extracts $defs into a map for $ref resolution), pub fn validate(&self, value: &Value) -> Vec<SchemaIssue> (entry point), pub fn iter_errors(&self, value: &Value) -> impl Iterator<Item=SchemaIssue> (matches jsonschema API shape for easy swap). Add 'pub mod mini_schema;' to lib.rs. Core dispatches to keyword handlers. SchemaIssue reuses schema::SchemaIssue type.
steps.done_when: mini_schema module compiles; Validator::new + validate + iter_errors exist; cargo build -p mp green

steps.action: Implement 'type' + 'required' + 'properties' keyword handlers in mini_schema.rs: check_type(value, schema_type) validates string/object/array/integer/boolean; check_required(obj, required_list) validates all required keys present; check_properties(obj, properties_schema) recurses into each property with validate(). Run cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_unit — type + required + properties tests should go green (TDD green phase 1).
steps.done_when: 18 type/required/properties unit tests pass (TDD green phase 1)

steps.action: Implement 'pattern' (regex) + 'enum' keyword handlers: check_pattern(value, pattern) uses regex::Regex to match strings; check_enum(value, allowed) checks membership. Cache compiled regexes in a HashMap inside Validator for performance. Run cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_unit — pattern + enum tests go green (TDD green phase 2).
steps.done_when: 26 total unit tests pass (TDD green phase 2: +8 pattern/enum)

steps.action: Implement 'minLength' + 'minItems' + 'minimum' keyword handlers: check_min_length(string, min), check_min_items(array, min), check_minimum(number, min). Run cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_unit — minLength/minItems/minimum tests go green (TDD green phase 3).
steps.done_when: 35 total unit tests pass (TDD green phase 3: +9 minLength/minItems/minimum)

steps.action: Implement 'items' + '$ref' (internal #/$defs/) + 'anyOf' keyword handlers: check_items(array, item_schema) recurses for each element; resolve_ref(ref_str) resolves #/$defs/<name> against the defs map (reject external refs); check_any_of(value, subschemas) tries each, passes if any match. Run cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_unit — items/ref/anyOf tests go green (TDD green phase 4).
steps.done_when: 45 total unit tests pass (TDD green phase 4: +10 items/ref/anyOf)

steps.action: Implement unsupported-keyword rejection: when the validator encounters oneOf, allOf, not, if/then/else, format, patternProperties, additionalProperties, or an external $ref (not #/$defs/), it returns a SchemaIssue with code 'SCH-02' and message 'unsupported keyword: X — mini_schema supports only type/required/properties/pattern/enum/minLength/minItems/minimum/items/$ref(internal)/anyOf'. Run cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_unit — unsupported keyword tests go green (TDD green phase complete: all 53 unit tests pass).
steps.done_when: All 53 unit tests pass (TDD green phase complete)

steps.action: Wire mini_schema into schema.rs: replace jsonschema::Validator with mini_schema::Validator in the validator() function and load_validator(). Keep jsonschema in Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies] for parity tests. The public API (validate_value, enforce_schema, enforce_milestone_file, etc.) stays identical — only the internal validator swaps. Run cargo build -p mp + cargo test -p mp (excluding parity tests) — all existing tests must pass with mini_schema as the validator.
steps.done_when: schema.rs uses mini_schema::Validator; jsonschema moved to [dev-dependencies]; cargo test -p mp green (existing tests pass with mini_schema)

steps.action: Extend tests/mini_schema_parity.rs: for each fixture in tests/fixtures/schema-corpus/, run BOTH jsonschema::Validator and mini_schema::Validator, assert identical pass/fail results AND that error counts match (or that both report at least one error for invalid). If any mismatch, fix mini_schema until 100% parity. This is the critical safety gate — mini_schema must not accept anything jsonschema rejects, and must not reject anything jsonschema accepts.
steps.done_when: cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_parity green; 100% parity across all fixtures (every valid passes both, every invalid fails both)

steps.action: Create tests/mini_schema_fixtures.rs: schema-specific fixture tests that load each schema (milestone, brief, track, idea, challenge, plan, spec-domain) and validate every fixture in the corresponding corpus subdir. Assert valid.json passes and each invalid-*.json fails with at least one SchemaIssue. Verify error messages are meaningful (contain the field name or keyword). This complements parity tests by asserting per-schema correctness, not just jsonschema equivalence.
steps.done_when: cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_fixtures green; all 7 schemas covered; ~50 fixtures asserted

steps.action: Create tests/mini_schema_e2e.rs: end-to-end tests that exercise the full CLI path with invalid input and confirm mp rejects it via mini_schema. Tests: (1) mp milestone create --json with missing title fails with schema error, (2) mp milestone create with bad spec_status enum fails, (3) mp track add with bad id pattern fails, (4) mp idea create with missing title fails, (5) mp brief done when brief has invalid topic id fails, (6) mp challenge start when challenge schema invalid fails, (7) mp milestone create with valid input succeeds (positive control), (8) mp milestone create with bad AC pattern fails, (9) mp milestone create with out_of_scope < 2 fails, (10) mp track add with neither done_when nor verification fails (anyOf). Use common::TestEnv harness from M17 WP1 (or local harness if M17 not done yet).
steps.done_when: cargo test -p mp --test mini_schema_e2e green; 10 e2e tests pass

steps.action: Run full test suite: cargo test -p mp (all tests including existing + new mini_schema tests). Fix any failures. Then run make adopt-check. steps.action: Remove jsonschema from Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies] entirely (parity tests should use a feature-gated jsonschema comparison module OR keep jsonschema as a test-only compile dependency gated behind a cargo feature).
